theme_and_concept.description: A highly advanced, technical, and precise visual node builder that feels like a space-flight launch sequence dashboard. It is data-dense, highly interactive, and relies on strict grids and precise technical typography. Runs inside a light-themed Laravel CRM, so it acts as a 'Command Center' module with high-contrast clinical light mode (crisp white, intricate blue grids, sharp neon accents for statuses).
theme_and_concept.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Adapted for Data/Technical UI)

global_rules.stack: Laravel Blade + Vanilla JS + CSS Variables. NO React, NO Tailwind assumptions. Use standard CSS classes.
global_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="node-trigger-drag"`).
global_rules.icons: FontAwesome or Lucide (as per CRM baseline).
global_rules.transparency: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, side panels, or sticky headers. Always use solid or heavily blurred backgrounds.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech
typography.headings: Chivo or IBM Plex Sans (Never Inter/Roboto/Open Sans). Weight: 700 or 800.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans (Clean, legible for dense data).
typography.technical_data: JetBrains Mono (Used for node IDs, timestamps, delay counts, and live tracking stats).

left_pane.name: Node Palette
left_pane.design: Solid white background, right border 1px solid var(--panel-border). Contains draggable node types grouped by category. Accordion-style layout. Each draggable item has a left color-bar indicating its category.

center_pane.name: Drawflow Canvas
center_pane.design: Dense blueprint grid background. Top edge contains the toolbar. Bottom right contains the minimap and zoom controls.

right_pane.name: Node Config & Tally Panel
right_pane.design: Slide-out or fixed solid panel. Left border 1px solid var(--panel-border). Holds per-node settings (template pickers, delay inputs, attachments) AND the 'Mission Tally / Onboarding Checklist'.

canvas_design.grid: Use a complex double-grid to look like a blueprint. 20px minor grid (light dots), 100px major grid (solid 1px lines).
canvas_design.toolbar: Floating glass panel at the top-center (`backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8)`). Houses Save, Validate, Reset, and view toggles.
canvas_design.minimap: Bottom-left or bottom-right floating widget. 1px solid border, dense shadow. Provides a bird's-eye view of the complex branch diagram.
canvas_design.help_icons: Strategically placed `fa-circle-info` icons next to complex terms. Hovering triggers a crisp, dark tooltip explaining the function (e.g., 'Triggers when lead stays in Pre-Sales 1 for > 24hrs').

node_design.container: Border-radius: 6px (crisp, slightly rounded). Background: var(--node-bg). Border: 1px solid var(--node-border). Left border is 4px solid matching the category color.
node_design.header: Padding: 8px 12px. Border-bottom: 1px solid var(--panel-border). Displays Category Icon (FA/Lucide) + Node Title. Font: JetBrains Mono, 12px, Uppercase.
node_design.body: Padding: 12px. Displays key configurations as a mini-summary. E.g., 'Delay: 2 Days' or 'Template: Welcome_v1'.
node_design.ports: Inputs/Outputs (drawflow endpoints). Size: 12px circle. Border: 2px solid white. Background: category color. Hover state: scale(1.2) + box-shadow glow.

types.action_wa: Green left-border. Icon: whatsapp. Displays template name.
types.condition: Amber left-border. Icon: code-branch. Has multiple output ports (True/False).
types.fallback: Red left-border. Icon: shield/alert. Handles failures.

live_lead_tracker_view.concept: Train-Tracking Board. The exact same Drawflow canvas is switched to 'Read-Only' mode. It tracks a specific lead's journey.
live_lead_tracker_view.top_progress_rail: A linear horizontal timeline across the top showing the 5 root stages: Lead Entry → Pre-Sales 1 → Pre-Sales 2 → Post-Sales → Customer. The current stage pulses.

node_states.completed: Grayscale, opacity 0.6. A green checkmark badge overlaps the top-right corner. Borders turn solid light gray.
node_states.active: Full opacity. Heavy box-shadow glow (`0 0 15px var(--primary-blue)`). Left color bar pulses brightly. A 'CURRENT' badge is attached to the top.
node_states.pending: Opacity 0.8. Border becomes dashed (`border: 1px dashed var(--text-muted)`). Background slightly dimmed. Text is muted.

edge_animations.active_path: Blue line with SVG stroke-dasharray animation ('ants marching' effect) moving TOWARDS the active node. `animation: dash 1s linear infinite`.

onboarding_checklist.location: Bottom half of the Right Config Panel, or a dedicated floating toggle.
onboarding_checklist.design: A 'Mission Requirements' tally board. As the user drags a 'Send WhatsApp' node to the canvas, the tally dynamically updates: 'WhatsApp Templates Required: 1/15'. Uses progress bars (Shadcn-style) to show completion state. Font: JetBrains Mono.

motion_and_microinteractions.node_drag: Cursor turns to grabbing. Node receives a larger drop-shadow (`shadow-2xl`) and scales up by 1.02x to feel detached from the canvas.
motion_and_microinteractions.edge_connect: Drawing a connection line snaps to the target port with a magnetic feel. The line turns vibrant blue when a valid connection is hovered.
motion_and_microinteractions.active_pulse: CSS keyframe `pulse-glow`: `0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(37,99,235,0.4); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(37,99,235,0); }` applied to the active node in Live Tracker mode.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
NEVER use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, Lato for headings.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties to avoid breaking transforms like zoom/pan in the canvas.
Use 2-3x more spacing in the configuration panels than feels comfortable. Cramped forms look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST have micro-animations (hover, focus, active states).
In Blade/Vanilla JS, implement tooltips using data-attributes and a tiny vanilla JS class, or pure CSS pseudo-elements to avoid external dependencies where possible.
Always ensure high contrast ratios (APCA preferred) for node data. Light text on dark nodes or dark text on light nodes must be highly legible.
Ensure the zoom and pan controls of Drawflow are smooth and not hindered by overlapping absolute UI elements.
